The Daily Challenge: one match a day with a twist

One match a day with a twist, a fairer rematch balance, and what happens if the app closes mid-match.

In short: The Claimball Daily Challenge is one match a day with a twist that changes from a set of variants. If the app closes in the middle of a Daily Challenge, you get that day's one attempt back, but leaving to the menu on purpose still uses it up. It is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android.

The Daily Challenge is one match a day with a twist, and it has grown over several test builds. They are not released to the public yet.

One match, one twist

Each day you get a single attempt. The twist changes from a set of variants, so the match is never quite the same twice in a row. It arrived in build 5.

Fairer rematches

In build 6 we re-balanced the Daily Challenge rematches so the toughest pairings are no longer nearly impossible or nearly automatic.

If the app closes

Build 7 handles the awkward cases. If the app closes in the middle of a Daily Challenge, you get that day's one attempt back. Leaving to the menu on purpose still uses it up. The system Back gesture or button during a Daily Challenge now pauses and resumes the match, and from other screens it takes you back to the menu instead of closing the app.

What is next

Claimball is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android. There is no release date yet.

FAQ

How many Daily Challenge attempts do I get?

Each day you get a single attempt. The twist changes from a set of variants, so the match is never quite the same twice in a row.

What if the app closes during a Daily Challenge?

You get that day's one attempt back. Leaving to the menu on purpose still uses it up.

What does the Back gesture or button do?

During a Daily Challenge it pauses and resumes the match, and from other screens it takes you back to the menu instead of closing the app.

Is Claimball released yet?

Not yet. It is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android, and there is no release date yet.

About the game: Claimball is a casual duel game on a notebook grid for iOS and Android (coming soon, not yet released).
